company.name: Moonvalley
company.shortDescription: Moonvalley is an AI research company that develops generative video tools that support filmmakers and creative teams.
company.description: Moonvalley develops generative video tools that support filmmakers and creative teams. The company offers Marey, an AI model designed for cinematic output, enabling users to control motion, camera, lighting, and sequencing through features like motion transfer and trajectory control. Its Voyager platform (in closed beta) provides a real-time canvas for granular creative direction across multiple cinematic layers. The company collaborates with studios, agencies, and filmmakers, positioning itself as a generative filmmaking partner rather than a replacement.

productsAndServices.description: A generative video model for creating image-to-video and text-to-video footage with controls for camera movement, poses, motion transfer, trajectories, keyframes, references, and shot extension.
productsAndServices.name: Marey

productsAndServices.description: An API-based access service for integrating Marey’s image-to-video and text-to-video generation capabilities into applications and creative workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Marey API
